items.heading: Ikan Sabuko
details: Key ingredients: tuna, tamarind, chili, coconut milk
Season tuna steaks with tamarind and chili.
Grill or fry the fish until just cooked.
Warm coconut milk with a little of the marinade.
Pour the sauce over the fish and serve with rice.

items.heading: Batar Da'an
details: Key ingredients: corn, pumpkin leaves, beans
Simmer dried corn kernels with beans until tender.
Add chopped pumpkin leaves and pumpkin.
Cook until everything softens into a hearty mixture.
Serve warm as a filling side dish.
